name: Sekai ga Kimi ni Yume Miteru
source:
Main character has been recently fired. A strange rabbit ears girl appears before him and invites him to return to school days. At school he needs to use a lot of different cute talking items to make girls happier. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角最近失业。一名长着兔耳朵的奇怪女孩出现在他面前，邀请他回到学生时代。在学校里，他需要使用各种可爱会说话的道具，让女孩们变得更加幸福。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
